title: Tonsil flushing
what: The doctor flushes your tonsils with a medicated solution. This washes out tonsil stones and pus.
why: For chronic tonsillitis, frequent sore throats, tonsil stones, and bad breath.
duration: usually 10 to 15 minutes; often a course of several sessions is given
tell_doctor: If you have a fever or an acute sore throat right now

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Best not to eat for 1 to 2 hours before, to avoid nausea.

prepare.title: Afterward
prepare.text: Do not plan to eat right after. You are usually told to wait.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: Your throat may be numbed with a spray
The doctor flushes the tonsils with a special syringe or device
The solution washes out the stones
You spit the solution into a tray
Sometimes medicine is applied to the tonsils
after: Do not eat or drink for about an hour, or as your doctor says
Finish the full course, if one is prescribed
red_flags: High fever, severe throat pain on one side, or trouble opening your mouth: see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Can I flush my tonsils at home?
faq.a: Gargling may help, but a doctor can wash out the stones properly.

faq.q: Will this help me avoid having my tonsils removed?
faq.a: It often helps. Whether surgery is needed is the doctor's decision.

reminders.text: Tonsil flushing in 2 hours. Best not to eat beforehand.
